help_menu: 🔢 COMMAND MENU 👇 Choose a category below to view commands. All commands use prefix: /
help_admins: 👑 ADMIN COMMANDS • /pause — Pause ongoing stream • /resume — Resume paused stream • /skip — Skip current track • /stop — Stop stream & clear queue • /seek [sec] — Seek forward • /seekback [sec] — Seek backward • /reload — Refresh admin cache
help_auth: ✅ AUTH COMMANDS Authorized users can control streams without admin rights. • /auth — Authorize a user • /unauth — Remove an authorized user
help_blist: 🎞 BLACKLIST COMMANDS Blacklisted chats and users cannot use the bot. • /blacklist [chat_id|user_id] — Blacklist • /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id] — Unblacklist
help_lang: ⚙ LANGUAGE COMMANDS Switch the bot's display language anytime. • /lang — Change chat language
help_ping: ⚡️ GENERAL & PING COMMANDS • /start — Start the bot • /help — Open command menu • /ping — Check latency & uptime • /sudolist — View sudo users
help_play: 🎵 PLAY COMMANDS Stream audio or video in group voice chats. • /play [query/url/reply] — Play audio • /vplay [query/url/reply] — Play video • Flags: -f (force play), -v (video) 🔎 Example: /play -f -v attention
help_queue: 🎶 QUEUE COMMANDS • /queue — View currently playing & queued tracks
help_sudo: 👑 SUDO COMMANDS • /ac — Active voice chats count • /activevc — Active voice chats list • /broadcast [reply] — Broadcast (-nochat, -user, -copy) • /eval — Run Python snippet • /logs — Fetch log file • /logger [on|off] — Toggle logger • /restart — Restart bot • /addsudo / /rmsudo — Manage sudoers
